  frai-gate init [--out <file>] [--ci]   Drop the RAI spec template into the repo (default: FRAI-SPEC.md);
                                         --ci also writes .github/workflows/rai-gate.yml so the gate
                                         runs on every PR
  frai-gate check <spec.md> [options]    Validate the spec's Responsible AI Gate
      --smart                            Add an AI quality review of the gate answers (Claude Agent SDK)
      --summary                          Print only a one-line summary (e.g., "BLOCK 5/7: evaluation, transparency")
      --json                             Machine-readable output
  frai-gate draft [--out <file>] [--print]
                                         Scan this repo with a read-only agent and draft a filled-in
                                         gate section grounded in the code (default out: rai-gate-draft.md)

Exit codes: 0 = PASS/WARN, 1 = BLOCK, 2 = usage/error.
The smart commands (draft, check --smart) use the Claude Agent SDK and need Claude Code
authentication or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Model override: FRAI_GATE_MODEL (default claude-opus-5).

Perfect! The implementation is complete and all tests pass. Here's a summary of what I've implemented:

## Summary of Changes

### 1. **Added `renderSummary()` function** (`src/gate/report.ts`)
   - Exports a function that formats gate results as a one-line summary
   - Format: `<VERDICT> <answered>/<total>` (e.g., `BLOCK 5/7: evaluation, transparency`)
   - Counts checks without block-severity findings
   - For BLOCK verdicts, appends affected check IDs in GATE_CHECKS order
   - Special case: returns `BLOCK 0/7: structure` when gate section is missing

### 2. **Added `--summary` flag to CLI** (`src/cli.ts`)
   - New flag for `frai-gate check <spec.md>` command
   - Prints only the one-line summary instead of full report
   - Respects priority: `--json` takes precedence if both flags are given
   - Exit codes unchanged (1 for BLOCK, 0 for PASS/WARN)
   - Updated usage help message

### 3. **Updated exports** (`src/index.ts`)
   - Added `renderSummary` to public API exports

### 4. **Added comprehensive tests** (`src/gate/report.test.ts`)
   - 8 test cases covering all verdict types and edge cases
   - Tests for proper check counting, ordering, and deduplication
   - All tests passing ✅

### Verification
- ✅ Build completes without errors
- ✅ All 19 tests pass (11 existing + 8 new)
- ✅ CLI correctly displays summary format
- ✅ Help text properly documented
- ✅ Flag priority working correctly (`--json` > `--summary`)
